title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE KOREA SHIPPING ASSOCIATION ACT
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters necessary for the enforcement of the Korea Shipping Association Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act").

Article 2 (Application for Authorization of Establishment)
An application for authorization under Article 9(5) of the Act shall be submitted with the articles of incorporation, accompanied by the following documents:
1. The names, addresses, and curricula vitae of persons selected as executive officers;
2. Letters of acceptance of appointment as executive officers;
3. A list of members;
4. A certified copy of the minutes of the inaugural general meeting;
5. A written statement outlining the details of each type of business.

Article 2-2 (Qualification Requirements for Auditors)
"External experts who meet the requirements prescribed by Presidential Decree" in Article 22(1)6 of the Act means persons falling under any of the following subparagraphs:
1. A person with at least five years of experience in finance- or accounting-related work at an institution subject to inspection under Article 38 of the Act on the Establishment of Financial Services Commission (including a corresponding foreign financial institution);
2. A person who, after obtaining a master's degree or higher in a field related to shipping or finance, has at least five years of experience as a researcher or in a position of assistant professor or higher at a research institute or university;
3. A person with at least five years of experience as a judge, prosecutor, or military judicial officer, or at least five years of experience as an attorney-at-law or certified public accountant;
4. A person with at least five years of experience in work related to law, finance, auditing, or accounting at a stock-listed corporation under Article 9(15)3 of the Financial Investment Services and Capital Markets Act;
5. A person with at least five years of experience in finance- or accounting-related work, or in the supervision of such work, in the State, a local government, a public institution under the Act on the Management of Public Institutions, or the Financial Supervisory Service under Article 24 of the Act on the Establishment of Financial Services Commission.

Article 2-3 Deleted <November 22, 2016>

Article 3 (Grounds for Dismissal of Executive Officers)
A resolution for dismissal under Article 24(1) of the Act may be adopted only where the executive officer concerned has committed an act falling under Articles 47 and 48 of the Act. <Amended on April 8, 1996>

Article 3-2 (Supervision by the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries)
(1) Where necessary for the supervision of the Korea Shipping Association (hereinafter referred to as the "Association") pursuant to Article 39(1) of the Act, the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries may require the Association to submit materials concerning its operations, have relevant public officials audit the Association's operations, and take necessary measures based on the results thereof.
(2) A public official conducting an audit under paragraph (1) shall carry identification indicating his or her authority and present it to the persons concerned.
(3) The Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall determine and publicly notify details, including the procedures and methods necessary to effectively perform supervision under Article 39(1) of the Act. In such cases, details, including the procedures and methods necessary to supervise the Association's mutual aid business under Article 6(1)4 of the Act, shall be publicly notified after prior consultation with the Financial Services Commission.

Article 4 (Standards for Imposing Administrative Fines)
The standards for imposing administrative fines under Article 48(1) and (2) of the Act shall be as specified in the attached Table. <Amended on November 22, 2016>

ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 4286, November 20, 1969>

This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDA (Organization of the Ministry of Construction and Transportation and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 14447, December 23, 1994>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted>

Articles 2 through 4 Omitted.

Article 5 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (153) Omitted.
(154) The Enforcement Decree of the Korea Shipping Association Act is amended as follows:
In subparagraph 2 of Article 4, "Minister of Transportation" shall be replaced with "Minister of Construction and Transportation."
(155) through (205) Omitted.

ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 14974, April 8, 1996>

This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDA (Organization of the Ministry of Oceans and Fisheries and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 15135, August 8, 1996>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Articles 2 through 6 Omitted.

Article 7 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (100) Omitted.
(101) The Enforcement Decree of the Korea Shipping Association Act is amended as follows:
In Article 4 (1) through (3), "Administrator of the Maritime and Port Administration" shall each be replaced with "Minister of Oceans and Fisheries."
(102) through (116) Omitted.

Article 8 Omitted.

ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 17224, May 16, 2001>

This Decree shall enter into force on July 1, 2001.

ADDENDA (Organization of the Ministry of Land, Transport and Maritime Affairs and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 20722, February 29, 2008>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation: Provided, That, among the Presidential Decrees amended pursuant to Article 6 of these Addenda, the portions amending Presidential Decrees promulgated before this Decree enters into force but whose enforcement dates have not yet arrived shall enter into force on the enforcement dates of the respective Presidential Decrees.

Articles 2 through 5 Omitted.

Article 6 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (114) Omitted.
(115) The Enforcement Decree of the Korea Shipping Association Act is partially amended as follows:
In Article 4 (1), the former part of paragraph (2) of that Article, and paragraph (3) of that Article, "Minister of Oceans and Fisheries" shall each be replaced with "Minister of Land, Transport and Maritime Affairs."
(116) through (138) Omitted.

ADDENDA (Decree Partially Amending the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Special Measures for Designation and Management of Development Restriction Zones and Other Decrees for Economic Revitalization and Relief of Public Inconvenience with a Focus on Ordinary Citizens) <Presidential Decree No. 22829, April 4, 2011>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

Article 2 (Applicability to Calculation of Floor Area Ratios Following Amendment of the Enforcement Decree of the Building Act)
The amended provisions of Article 119 (1) 4 (d) of the Enforcement Decree of the Building Act shall apply beginning with the first case in which a building permit is obtained after this Decree enters into force.

Article 3 (Applicability to Approval of Changes Following Amendment of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Improvement of Urban Areas and Residential Environments)
The amended provisions of subparagraph 3 of Article 27 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Improvement of Urban Areas and Residential Environments shall apply beginning with the first change to the details of authorization for establishment of an association after this Decree enters into force.

Article 4 (Transitional Measures concerning Penalty Surcharges or Administrative Fines)
(1) The former provisions shall apply when applying the standards for imposing penalty surcharges or administrative fines to violations committed before this Decree enters into force.
(2) Dispositions imposing penalty surcharges or administrative fines for violations committed before this Decree enters into force shall not be included in calculating the number of violations under the amended provisions of this Decree.

ADDENDA (Organization of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 24443, March 23, 2013>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted>

Articles 2 through 5 Omitted.

Article 6 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (129) Omitted.
(130) The Enforcement Decree of the Korea Shipping Association Act is partially amended as follows:
In the violation columns for subparagraph 2 (a), (c), and (f) of the attached Table, "Minister of Land, Transport and Maritime Affairs" shall each be replaced with "Minister of Oceans and Fisheries."
(131) through (146) Omitted.

ADDENDUM <Presidential Decree No. 27604, November 22, 2016>

This Decree shall enter into force on November 30, 2016.
